title: Microglial SIRT3 restrains maladaptive inflammatory–phagocytic activation and neuronal vulnerability in acute tau models
title_zh: 小胶质细胞 SIRT3 抑制急性 Tau 模型中适应不良的炎症-吞噬激活和神经元易损性
abstract: Abstract Background Tau pathology is a defining feature of Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and related tauopathies. Microglia play important roles in tau uptake, clearance, and propagation, yet the mechanisms that govern their functional responses to tau-associated stress remain incompletely understood. Sirtuin-3 (SIRT3), an NAD + -dependent deacetylase predominantly localized to mitochondria, is a key regulator of mitochondrial integrity and metabolic homeostasis; however, its role in microglial responses to tau pathology remains unclear. Methods We employed complementary in vitro and in vivo models to investigate the role of microglial SIRT3 under tau-associated conditions. SIRT3-deficient HMC3 cells and human monocyte-derived microglia-like cells (MDMi) were assessed for mitochondrial integrity, inflammatory activation, tau uptake, and metabolic alterations using transcriptomic and functional metabolic analyses. In vivo, microglia-specific inducible SIRT3 knockout mice were examined in acute tau challenge models using fluorescently labeled and disease-associated tau preparations to assess neuroinflammatory responses, tau accumulation, mitochondrial damage, and neuronal vulnerability. In addition, AD-derived MDMi and postmortem cortical tissues were analyzed to examine microglial SIRT3 expression in relation to tau pathology. Results SIRT3 deficiency caused marked mitochondrial structural abnormalities and functional impairment in microglia, accompanied by increased ROS production, enhanced migration, inflammatory activation, and increased uptake of tau. Transcriptomic profiling and functional metabolic analyses further demonstrated a shift toward glycolysis-biased metabolism together with activation of stress- and microenvironment-responsive transcriptional programs. In vivo, microglia-specific SIRT3 deletion exacerbated neuroinflammatory responses, tau accumulation, mitochondrial damage, and neuronal vulnerability in acute tau challenge models using fluorescently labeled and disease-associated tau preparations. Notably, SIRT3 expression was increased in AD patient-derived MDMi and in microglia within postmortem cortical regions with high tau burden in AD patients. Consistent with a context-dependent response, tau exposure induced dynamic changes in microglial SIRT3 expression over time. Conclusions Microglial SIRT3 functions as a stress-responsive metabolic checkpoint linking mitochondrial homeostasis to inflammatory–phagocytic activation under acute tau-associated stress. SIRT3 deficiency promotes mitochondrial dysfunction, inflammatory activation, glycolysis-biased metabolic remodeling, and altered tau handling, which are associated with increased neuronal vulnerability. These findings identify SIRT3-dependent mitochondrial regulation as an important component of microglial response to tau-associated stress and provide a framework for further investigating how metabolic dysfunction contributes to microglial maladaptation in tau-related neurodegenerative diseases.
abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 Tau 病理是阿尔茨海默病（AD）及相关 Tau 病的决定性特征。小胶质细胞在 Tau 摄取、清除和传播中发挥重要作用，但支配其对 Tau 相关压力功能反应的机制尚未完全阐明。烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸（NAD+）依赖性去乙酰酶、主要定位于线粒体的西尔图因-3（SIRT3）是线粒体完整性和代谢稳态的关键调节因子；然而，SIRT3 在小胶质细胞对 Tau 病理反应中的作用尚不明确。方法 我们采用体外和体内互补模型，研究 Tau 相关条件下小胶质细胞 SIRT3 的作用。使用转录组学和功能代谢分析，评估 SIRT3 缺乏的 HMC3 细胞和人单核细胞来源的小胶质细胞样细胞（MDMi）的线粒体完整性、炎症激活、Tau 摄取和代谢改变。在体内实验中，在使用荧光标记和疾病相关 Tau 制剂的急性 Tau 挑战模型中检查小胶质细胞特异性诱导性 SIRT3 敲除小鼠，以评估神经炎症反应、Tau 累积、线粒体损伤和神经元易损性。此外，分析 AD 患者来源的 MDMi 和尸体皮质组织，以检查小胶质细胞 SIRT3 表达与 Tau 病理的关系。结果 SIRT3 缺乏导致小胶质细胞线粒体结构显著异常和功能障碍，伴随 ROS 产生增加、迁移增强、炎症激活和 Tau 摄取增加。转录组谱分析和功能代谢分析进一步显示向糖酵解偏向性代谢转变，以及压力和微环境响应性转录程序的激活。体内实验表明，小胶质细胞特异性 SIRT3 缺失加重了荧光标记和疾病相关 Tau 制剂急性 Tau 挑战模型中的神经炎症反应、Tau 累积、线粒体损伤和神经元易损性。值得注意的是，AD 患者来源的 MDMi 和 AD 患者尸体皮质高 Tau 负荷区域中的小胶质细胞 SIRT3 表达增加。符合依赖环境的反应，Tau 暴露诱导小胶质细胞 SIRT3 表达随时间发生动态变化。结论 小胶质细胞 SIRT3 作为一种响应压力的代谢检查点，将线粒体稳态与急性 Tau 相关压力下的炎症-吞噬激活联系起来。SIRT3 缺乏促进线粒体功能障碍、炎症激活、糖酵解偏向性代谢重塑和 Tau 处理改变，这些与神经元易损性增加相关。这些发现将 SIRT3 依赖的线粒体调节确定为小胶质细胞对 Tau 相关压力反应的重要组成部分，并为进一步探讨代谢功能障碍如何导致 Tau 相关神经退行性疾病中小胶质细胞适应不良提供了框架。
